title: An Empirical Study of Evaluating Long-form Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Dividing answers into length bins and analyzing the correlation between answer length and automatic evaluation metric scores.

Classifying questions into different categories (e.g., reasoning, instruction, evidence-based) and calculating the correlation consistency between human evaluators' scores and various metrics for each category.
Using Large Language Models as both evaluators and generators to conduct pairwise comparisons, measuring whether evaluators assign higher scores or win rates to their own generated answers.
Computing the average inverse document frequency (IDF) of words within answers and examining its correlation with evaluation scores to determine if evaluators favor verbose or lexically rare content.
